request.description: Health check — confirms the server is running and reachable.
Returns the current list of names stored in the MongoDB 'people' collection as a JSON array.
Adds a new name to the MongoDB 'people' collection. Sends a JSON body with a single 'name' field. Returns the full updated names array.

Opens a Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream. The connection stays open and the server pushes the updated names array whenever a new name is added via POST /api/names.

NOTE: Postman will show the stream as it arrives. The connection won't close on its own — click 'Cancel' in Postman to end it.
